title: Source-section comparison data and its unchanged normalization predicate
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, and a finite-field datum $D$ with algebraically closed field $k$ [def-trf-coefficient-conventions]. On $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ use integral modules and their derived category [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], the completed pullback [def-pur-integral-derived-operations], exact point sections [def-weil-finite-coefficient-point], the specified inverse-image comparison [def-weil-inverse-image-pullback-comparison] and quotient-stalk towers [lem-trf-bounded-quotient-stalk-realization]. Define trfSourceSectionConeLift as the composite of chain restriction, inverseImageRoosComparisonComplex, the sections Roos comparison and the quotient germ tower map. Define j as derived restriction followed by sections of the specified kappa. Define c as sections of the inverse identity unit, inverse specified compositor, and canonical identity-composition equality transport. TrfSourceSectionData packages I with its coherence proof and the isomorphisms sigma, rho, e and R together with the natural identity lift a_0. TrfSourceSectionNormalized is the unchanged conjunction of its section/derived restriction, finite germs, reparametrization, two identity coordinates, chain and derived naturality, realization isomorphisms and arbitrary-representative comparison equations. These are the five original constructions extracted verbatim; this node asserts no existence theorem.
